comment: LHR validation and historical validity — Existing provenance and versioning requirements are useful. These additions make semantic specificity, historical validity, and derived representations explicit rather than adding a duplicate record system.

public.text: LHR validation and historical validity — Existing provenance and versioning requirements are useful. These additions make semantic specificity, historical validity, and derived representations explicit rather than adding a duplicate record system.
public.suggestedRevision: Append; retain Required status: Validation shall use the declared profile and terminology release, distinguish code or expression validity from clinical coding correctness, and return actionable findings. An identifier valid in the recorded historical release shall not be rejected solely because it has subsequently been retired. Reconciliation and any recoding shall preserve the source record and provenance.
